title: Field Cut Step by Step
lede: One small step at a time. Do the step. Tap the green button. Move on. Your place is saved if you stop.

steps.title: Open Field Cut
do: Open **Finder**. Press [[Cmd + Shift + G]].
Paste **~/ClaudeCodeTest/field-cut** and press Return.
Double-click **index.html**.
steps.see: Field Cut opens in your browser with a dark screen and a **Load footage** button.
steps.tip: Use Chrome. If it opens somewhere else, right-click index.html, pick **Open With**, then **Google Chrome**. Bookmark the page so it is one click next time. Or double-click **Field Cut** on your Desktop.

steps.title: Load your videos
do: Click the orange **Load footage** button.
Pick your videos. Or drag them onto the page.
steps.see: Your videos line up on the left under **Footage**.
steps.caption: Click Load footage (circled).
steps.alt: Field Cut with the Load footage button circled

steps.title: Find the good part
steps.where: The picture strip under the big screen.
do: Click a video on the left to watch it.
Drag along the strip to move through it. Or press [[Space]] to play and stop.
steps.see: The big screen shows the moment you stop on.
steps.caption: Drag along the strip (circled).
steps.alt: Picture strip under the viewer circled

steps.title: Mark the start and the end
steps.where: The green In and red Out buttons, or your keys.
do: Press [[I]] where the good part starts.
Press [[O]] where it ends.
steps.see: **IN** and **OUT** times appear at the bottom. A green line and a gold bar show on the strip.
steps.caption: In and Out marks (circled).

steps.title: Save it as a clip
do: Press [[Enter]].
steps.see: A new clip appears under **Clips** and a message says it saved.
steps.tip: Repeat steps 3, 4 and 5 for every good moment before you fix anything.
steps.caption: Your clip shows up here (circled).
steps.alt: Clips list with a new clip circled

steps.title: Cut more pieces from the same video
steps.where: Same video. The play strip and the **In** and **Out** buttons.
do: Move to the next talking point you want to keep.
Press [[I]] where it starts. Press [[O]] where it ends.
Press [[Enter]] to save it as a clip.
Do this for each talking point. Skip the parts you do not need.
steps.see: Each piece is a new clip on the left. Gold bars on the strip show what you kept.
steps.tip: Cut a little off? Fix it in the next step. No need to start over.
steps.caption: Your pieces: the clip list and the gold bars (circled).

steps.title: Fix a cut that is a little off
steps.where: Click the clip on the left. Two buttons appear at the bottom.
do: Click the clip you want to fix.
Move the playhead to the new start. Click **Start here**.
Move the playhead to the new end. Click **End here**.
Keys work too: [[ [ ]] for start, [[ ] ]] for end.
steps.see: The time under the clip name changes. A message says how long the clip is now.
steps.tip: A clip must stay at least 0.3 seconds long. Use [[Left]] and [[Right]] to move one frame at a time.
steps.caption: Start here and End here (circled).
steps.alt: Start here and End here circled

steps.title: Put the pieces in the right order
steps.where: Left side, **Clips** list. Arrows are on the right of each clip.
do: Click ▲ to move a clip up.
Click ▼ to move it down.
Click ✕ to throw a clip away.
Untick a box to leave a clip out for now.
steps.see: The small number under each name (01, 02, 03) is the order. The joined video plays top to bottom.
steps.tip: Names stay the same when you move clips. Only the small number changes. ✕ never touches your original video.
steps.caption: Order arrows (circled).

steps.title: Watch the joined video
do: Tick the clips you want. Untick the rest.
Click **Play joined**.
Watch and listen. Click **Stop preview** to stop.
steps.see: Clips play top to bottom. The clip playing is highlighted on the left. The button says **Stop preview**.
steps.tip: Same-video pieces play right after each other. A tiny pause may show when pieces come from different videos. The exported video has none.
steps.caption: Play joined (circled).

steps.title: Save your work
do: Press [[Cmd + S]]. Or click **Save project**.
Pick a place for the file. Click Save.
steps.see: A message says **Project saved**. You now have a file ending in **.fieldcut.json**.
steps.tip: Save again after big changes. The file holds your clips and fixes. It does not hold your videos, so keep those safe too.
steps.caption: Save project (circled).

steps.title: Pick a clip to fix
do: Click a clip.
steps.see: The clip gets an orange box. The top right says **Editing clip** and its name.
steps.caption: The picked clip (circled).
steps.alt: Selected clip with orange box circled

steps.title: Make the colors right
steps.where: Right side, **Color** tab, then **Quick fix** and **Look**.
do: Press [[A]] or click **Auto**. That is enough for most shots.
Same lighting all night? Scroll down and click **Apply to all clips**.
steps.see: The picture gets brighter and cleaner right away.
steps.tip: **Natural** is the safe pick for news. The **A** looks are your portfolio styles.
steps.caption: Auto (circled).
steps.alt: Auto button circled in the Color tab

steps.title: Check your fix
do: Click **Before / after**.
Click it again to turn it off.
steps.see: The left half is the old picture. The right half is your fix.
steps.caption: Before / after (circled).

steps.title: Pick where it is going
steps.where: Bar under the big screen, the size buttons.
do: Click the size for the app: **16:9**, **9:16**, **4:5** or **1:1**.
Drag the picture so the person stays in the box.
Click **Safe zones**. Keep faces inside the bright box, away from the edges. Apps cover the edges.
steps.see: The bright box changes shape. Safe zones add guide lines on the picture.
steps.caption: The size buttons (circled).

steps.title: Make voices clear
steps.where: Right side, **Audio** tab. The meter is under the big screen.
do: Leave **Voice clarity** on.
Play the clip. Talking should reach about -12 to -6 on the meter.
Too quiet? Raise **Level**.
steps.see: The meter bounces while someone talks.
steps.caption: Voice clarity (circled).

steps.title: Add your name (only if you want)
steps.where: Right side, **Text** tab, then **Watermark all exports**.
do: Tick **Add a credit** to put your name in the corner.
Skip this step to add nothing.
steps.see: Your credit shows in the corner of the picture.
steps.caption: Add a credit (circled).

steps.title: Join the pieces into one video
do: Open the **Clips** menu.
Choose **Join ticked clips into one video**.
Tick only the clips you want in it.
steps.see: One file per size. Its name ends in **_Sequence**.
steps.tip: Pieces play back to back with straight cuts. Want a soft blend? See the next step. If colors differ, use **Apply to all clips** in the **Color** tab.
steps.caption: Clips menu set to Join (circled).

steps.title: Blend the pieces with a crossfade
steps.where: Right side, **Export** tab. Two menus appear under **Clips** after you pick Join.
do: Open **Between clips**. Pick **Straight cut** or **Crossfade**.
For a crossfade, open **Crossfade length**. Pick a time.
Click **Export ticked clips**.
steps.see: Picture and sound melt from one clip into the next. The video is shorter by one blend for each join.
steps.tip: Start with 0.5 seconds. Shorter feels like a cut. Longer feels dreamy. **Play joined** still shows straight cuts, so check the exported file.
steps.caption: Between clips and Crossfade length (circled).

steps.title: Make the videos
do: Tick the sizes you want. One to three is plenty.
Tick the clips you want on the left (the little boxes).
Click **Export ticked clips**.
steps.see: Progress bars fill. The last part says **Finishing**. A video takes about as long as it plays.
steps.tip: Keep this tab open and in front until it finishes. A 5 minute video takes about 5 and a half minutes. If you see red text about memory, tick fewer sizes.
steps.caption: Export ticked clips (circled).

steps.title: Save the videos to your Mac
do: Click **Save** next to each file. Or click **Save all**.
If Chrome asks about downloading several files, click **Allow**.
steps.see: The button says **Saved**. The files are in your **Downloads** folder.
steps.caption: Finished files (circled).

steps.title: Come back to it later
do: Open Field Cut again (step 1).
Click **Open project** and pick your **.fieldcut.json** file.
Drag the same videos onto the page.
steps.see: A note says the project is waiting for your videos. Once they load, your clips come back with their fixes.
steps.caption: Open project (circled).

steps.title: Forgot a key?
do: Click **Shortcuts**.
steps.see: Every key is listed.
steps.caption: Shortcuts (circled).

stuck.fix: Click the empty dark area of the page first. A typing box may have grabbed your keys.

stuck.problem: It says it cannot read my video.
stuck.fix: Phone video from Photos: export it again as **Most Compatible**, then load that.

stuck.problem: My joined video is in the wrong order.
stuck.fix: Use ▲ and ▼ on the left to move clips. The top clip plays first. Then export again.

stuck.problem: My joined video has only one clip.
stuck.fix: Tick every clip you want in the list on the left. Then check **Clips** says Join.
Tick at least one clip on the left first. Then click **Play joined** again.

stuck.problem: I do not see the Crossfade menus.
stuck.fix: Set the **Clips** menu to **Join ticked clips into one video** first. The crossfade menus show up under it.

stuck.problem: It says crossfade needs Fast export.
stuck.fix: That video cannot use the fast way. The export used straight cuts. Try a clip that came straight from your camera.

stuck.problem: It says fast export is not possible for this file.
stuck.fix: Nothing is wrong. It switches to a slower mode and still finishes. Keep the tab open.

stuck.problem: The export stopped with an error.
stuck.fix: Tick fewer sizes, pick **Standard** quality, close other tabs and apps, and try again.
Tick fewer sizes or export fewer clips at a time.

stuck.problem: The page went blank or I closed it.
stuck.fix: Open Field Cut again (step 1). Use **Open project** and drop your videos in (step 15).

stuck.problem: I do not hear sound while exporting.
stuck.fix: That is normal. The file still has sound. Tick **Play sound while exporting** if you want to hear it.

stuck.problem: I do not know what to do next.
stuck.fix: Click **Where was I?** at the top. It jumps to your next step.

finish_text: Your videos are in Downloads. Take a break.
